turns.q: My tracking says delivered but I didn't receive it, what now?
turns.replyTail:
I am sorry this has happened. If your tracking shows delivered but you have not received the parcel, please first check with a neighbour, household member, doorman, building staff, and any usual delivery locations. Please also review the shipping address and contact the carrier for any additional delivery details. If it was marked delivered very recently, please allow 2 business days, as parcels can occasionally appear shortly after the delivery scan.
